name: fast-image
title: Fast Image
description: This extension allows you to quickly select and insert images from your own local library. Maintain your library of diagrams or throw your favorite memes into work chats.
author: diemonic1

preferences.name: folder
preferences.title: Images Folder
preferences.description: Select images folder. Every image inside it, including subfolders, becomes searchable.

preferences.name: fillGridItems
preferences.title: Thumbnail Fit
preferences.label: Fill grid cells (crop to fill instead of showing the full image)
preferences.description: When enabled, thumbnails fill their square without distortion, cropping any overflow. When disabled, the full image is always fully visible, letterboxed if needed.

preferences.name: autoRefreshInterval
preferences.title: Auto Refresh
preferences.description: How often Fast Image automatically rescans your images folder for new or removed files. Manually refreshing the list also resets this timer. If you have a very large image library, more frequent scans can slow down opening the extension — you can always refresh manually using the Refresh Images List action inside the extension.

commands.name: images
commands.title: Fast Image
commands.subtitle: Search and paste local images
commands.description: Search your local image library and instantly copy or paste images into the active application.
